verdict.rationale: Galileo's release notes mention an in-product AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems, which is a first-party way to get AI-driven insights from your own trace data. That evidence is a single one-line mention with no detail on what the assistant analyzes, what insights or suggestions it produces, or how it is used. LLM-as-a-judge metrics and metric auto-tuning are evaluation features, not insight or suggestion generation, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of the AI Assistant's capabilities and scope, evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations from user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Troubleshoot your agentic system with the AI Assistant.
